answer: Work waits on the comet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the forge of the next round. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, reset on any identity-link attempt, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the dune of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
